summary: Fairly level kerb on a quiet loop street, homes 19-20 m away on both sides.
reasons: Quiet residential street, no parking convention

drivers.seclusion: Mapped dwellings 19-20 m away on the north side and more across the road to the south; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed through street with a planted verge and trees along the north kerb; room to stop looks workable but not generous.
drivers.convention: One car parked at the west bend; no general parking convention seen.

flags: Homes within about 25 m all round
Steep overall: 8.6% mean, 19% max, but about 1% at the best section
sun_shade: Street trees and verge shrubs shade the north kerb from the south and west; open to the north.

best_section.where: North kerb through the bend at the top of the hill, before the straight
